hero_power_blueprint.subject: A single warm parchment blueprint unfurls in midair above a brass drafting table while an articulated steel compass pins one corner and traces a clean arc-blue construction line across an unfinished gear assembly. Three small brass components rise from the page into their intended positions, making planning feel precise and physical rather than magical spectacle.
hero_power_blueprint.perspective: Close overhead three-quarter view with the parchment, compass, arc-blue line, and rising components centered inside the middle 70%.
hero_power_blueprint.background: A cool charcoal workshop bench with blurred iron tools and deep blue-grey shadow, opposing the parchment amber and polished brass focal objects.
hero_power_blueprint.notes: Show no readable labels, numerals, diagrams, hands, finished construct, or city-scale plan; the blueprint itself is the one subject.

token_gear_wisp.subject: A palm-sized Gear Wisp formed from three mismatched brass cogs orbiting a bright arc-blue core, with two tiny copper stabilizer fins and a loose coil spring trailing like a tail. It hovers with a slight mechanical wobble, newly assembled and useful rather than cute or animal-like.
token_gear_wisp.perspective: Close eye-level three-quarter portrait with the entire small wisp centered and loose negative space around its clean circular silhouette.
token_gear_wisp.background: A dark oiled-steel parts drawer and cool slate workshop wall, softly blurred so the warm brass and arc-blue core read at mobile size.
token_gear_wisp.notes: Keep it visibly smaller and simpler than Assembly Drone: no limbs, face, swarm, tools, text, or large machinery.

hero_power_shadow_mark.subject: A narrow blade-silver assassin's seal pressed into a small disk of black sealing wax, its center pierced by one toxic-lime pinprick while midnight-purple shadow smoke curls inward toward the mark. The seal rests beside a closed bone-white glove, suggesting a chosen target without depicting the victim.
hero_power_shadow_mark.perspective: Tight top-down close view with the wax seal, silver edge, and green puncture centered as one instantly readable symbol-like object.
hero_power_shadow_mark.background: A warm amber-brown wooden table lit by a distant candle, providing strong temperature and value contrast behind the black wax and cold silver.
hero_power_shadow_mark.notes: No letters, runes, target reticle, skull icon, blood, victim, readable contract, or UI symbol; the mark must remain an original physical seal.

hero_power_earthwall.subject: Three interlocking granite slabs thrust upward from cracked ground into a compact crescent wall, their iron-black bases wedged together and thin pale-quartz seams glowing where the stones lock. Small moss patches and one rusted-bronze brace make the barrier feel old, repaired, and immovable.
hero_power_earthwall.perspective: Low frontal three-quarter view at ground height with the complete crescent barrier centered and both ends visible inside the middle 70%.
hero_power_earthwall.background: A warm ember-orange dusk over a softly blurred ruined road, separating the cool grey stone wall from the horizon.
hero_power_earthwall.notes: No defender, castle, giant cliff, explosive eruption, carved writing, or projectile; this is a local protective wall.

token_stone_shard.subject: A knee-high wedge of dark granite stands upright on two broad rubble feet, its front face naturally split into a shield-like plane with one pale-quartz eye glowing from a narrow crack. A rusted-bronze staple binds a broken corner and a tuft of moss grows from the rear seam.
token_stone_shard.perspective: Close low eye-level portrait with the entire small shard construct, both feet, and repaired corner clearly contained in the central frame.
token_stone_shard.background: A warm lantern-lit mason's yard of ochre dust and blurred timber braces, opposing the shard's cool iron-grey mass.
token_stone_shard.notes: Bulwark reads through the broad planted wedge. Keep it smaller and more primitive than Pebble Sentinel, with no arms, weapon, mouth, or giant scale.

hero_power_chain_spark.subject: One marble-sized cyan spark leaps between two suspended storm-silver conductor rings, leaving a sharp gold-white double-trace that bends once at each ring. The second ring has just begun to glow, capturing the instant energy chains onward without becoming a full lightning storm.
hero_power_chain_spark.perspective: Macro side-on three-quarter view with both conductor rings and the complete zigzag spark path centered inside the middle 70%.
hero_power_chain_spark.background: A deep charcoal stormcloud chamber with soft violet-grey vapor, maximizing contrast around the cyan and gold-white electrical line.
hero_power_chain_spark.notes: No caster, enemy figures, readable apparatus labels, giant bolt, explosion, or more than two rings; keep the effect compact and controlled.
